text:
Sofia: Quick thread for Priya (new SWE) 6/1 start but consular stamping got pushed. Can we outline payroll/benefits/onboarding options if she arrives late?
Ethan: Manager is fine with remote ramp for up to 3 weeks. Wants clarity on whether we can ship laptop before payroll.
Priya: Thanks — embassy moved my appointment to May 29, expect back to US around June 4. I currently have no US work auth yet.
Sofia: TL;DR: 1) Cannot put on W-2 payroll until work auth confirmed. 2) We can ship equipment and give access for training pre-payroll (must sign equipment agreement). 3) Benefits (medical, 401k) effective date ties to payroll start; if start >30 days we need benefits ops to reopen enrollment.
Ethan: If manager wants to pay earlier we can do contractor via staffing partner (need approval from Legal). That will be 1099/agency; benefits not included.
Priya: Who pays for passport courier & appointment fees? And what about travel reimbursements?
Sofia: Redwood covers reasonable consular courier fees and one-way travel for stamping where policy applies. Submit receipts to hr-expenses@redwood.com. Travel reimbursements follow travel policy limits.
HiringBot: Action: upload passport scan + DS-160 confirmation to candidate portal https://immigration.redwood.example/upload. Missing files: passport.pdf, ds160.pdf
Priya: I have a friend who is a notary and can do i9 attestation in my city. Is that acceptable for remote I-9?
PayrollBot: Remote I-9 allowed with approved agent/notary. Please upload agent attestation form (see https://hr.redwood.example/i9-remote). Payroll note: we'll create a tentative HRIS start date but hold pay until E-Verify / documents cleared.
Ethan: Also confirm PTO accrual: does it start from tentative date or actual payroll date?
Sofia: PTO accrual begins on payroll effective date. We can grant occasional paid administrative time if manager requests pre-payroll orientation, but that's discretionary and requires People Ops sign-off.
Priya: If stamping takes >3 weeks, manager asked about bridging via contractor. What is turnaround for Legal approval?
Sofia: Legal usually turns contractor bridging approvals within 48 hours if manager confirms scope and budget. Raj (Legal) will vet classification risk.
Priya: I'll upload docs tonight. Thanks all.
Ethan: I'll approve equipment ship once Sofia confirms equipment agreement and hiring team cover code access training plan.
Sofia: Checklist: upload passport & DS-160, provide notary attestation, confirm travel receipts after stamping, manager confirm whether to engage staffing partner if >3 weeks. I'll follow up with benefits ops to watch enrollment windows. :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya: Appreciate it — will update when appointment is done.
HiringBot: Reminder: candidate portal link and upload deadline 72 hours after appointment slots are confirmed.
